title: BiAxisAudit: A Novel Framework to Evaluate LLM Bias Across Prompt Sensitivity and Response-Layer Divergence

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to stereotype statements across a factorial grid of prompt dimensions (task format, perspective, role, sentiment), using Split Coding to independently measure Bias Endorsement Rate (BER) in the model's discrete selections and free-text elaborations.
